message.content:
Text overlap between the large background heading ("Provide INR liquidity...") and the main navigation bar.
Excessive decimal precision in the "Est. monthly earnings" (5,576.9231) and "Est. yearly earnings" (66,923.0769) figures, which looks like unformatted raw data.
The "USDT" label for the yearly earnings is wrapped to a second line, creating an awkward vertical layout compared to the monthly earnings block.
